_readme: Said by the hooks while the player is carrying the key and has not yet been inside.
It is the whole next leg stated once - but it is NOT the only place any of it is said.
The lantern's own refusal names the oil and the hermit, and warden_keeper_down repeats all
of it, because this line stops being reachable the moment the Keeper falls.

notice.speaker: Warden
notice.text: That is the key. You found it in an afternoon.

shrug.speaker: Warden
shrug.text: Go on, then. The gate is east, and it has been shut a long time. Whatever took the keep is still in there.

light.speaker: Warden
light.text: And take a light. The lantern in there ran dry years ago - the hermit in the cave east of the town hoards oil by the flask.
